$description: Lumen design tokens — canonical source of the theme-token pipeline (doc 08 §3.1, card 1.B4). Re-pinned 2026-11-11 to the W25 Figma redesign measured values (design/figma-fidelity-spec.md §1; mined from design/figma/ — 102 SVG exports). Every value is [VERIFY-DESIGN] per doc 08 §1.1-§1.4 unless its description marks it [PROPOSAL]. Figma export annotation chrome is excluded per doc 08 §1.1-1.2 (purple #8A38F5 dashed frames, 4.5px annotation radii, 20px annotation insets, artboard-scaled stroke copies 0.825/1.125/1.28571). Element sizes and layout (window 1920x1080, topbar 40, control bar 54, rail 50, playlist 377, control heights 28/32/34/36/48, item pitch 42) are NOT tokens — layout config owns them (doc 01 §2.3d). Layer grammar per doc 08 §3.2: primitive (raw, never consumed by components) -> alias (theme-role) -> semantic (the only consumable layer).

lumen.tokens.format: W3C Design Tokens draft subset (nested groups, $value/$type/$description, {dotted.path} alias references, group $type inheritance) plus one lumen extension: a $value that is a JSON object whose keys are all registered mode names is a per-mode value [PROPOSAL — doc 08 §3.1 requires per-mode values; modes are not in the DTCG draft yet]
lumen.tokens.accent-derivation: alternate-accent ramps are computed by the theme-tokens crate (doc 08 §3.3): HSL shifts calibrated on the mined orange family, on-accent glyph chosen as the first candidate with WCAG contrast >= 4.5:1 against the accent primary — the candidates are the W25 neutrals #161616 (gray.750), #090909 (gray.900), #EAEAEA (gray.100) plus the pure-white fallback #FFFFFF (gray.0, [PROPOSAL — card 1.B4-R]) needed because the violet accent reaches 4.5:1 against none of the others; the default (orange) ramp is the mined family from the token file [re-pin when the Figma file provides the real ramps]
lumen.tokens.provenance: W25 spec §1 (design/figma-fidelity-spec.md, 2026-11-11): neutral near-black surfaces, one sparing orange accent, Inter face; hex frequency re-mined 2026-11 from design/figma/ (102 SVG exports) with scripts/extract_design_tokens.py methodology (doc 08 §1.2-§1.4)

primitive.$description: Layer 1 of 3 (doc 08 §3.2): raw, extraction-accurate values. Never consumed by components; exists for re-derivation and diffing against the future Figma variables. Gray step numbers: lightness-ranked, 900=#090909 down to 0=#FFFFFF — the W25 neutral ramp (fidelity spec §1); warm-tinted Solstice steps removed 2026-11-11. Gray long-tail consolidation per doc 08 §3.4 [PROPOSAL]: #1B1B1B stays distinct from #191919/#222222; #171717 consolidated into #161616; #1E1E1E/#202020 consolidated into #1F1F1F.

color.$description: Neutral ramp + accent family + special colors. Dark-theme values from the W25 whole-corpus fill/stroke counts (fidelity spec §1).

This step MEASURES 4.95:1 on chrome, 5.86:1 on deep, 5.94:1 on the settings window #bcbbbc, 6.39:1 on surface, 6.66:1 on panel, 6.87:1 on muted, 8.45:1 on raised — AA on every light surface. orange.$description: THE product accent family (W25 §1): the VLC orange — default accent. Steps are the mined ramp (doc 08 §1.2): primary + tonal variants.

300.$description: hover / lighter accent on light (W25 accent.bright)

400.$description: light-theme accent icon tints (Player - Light.svg, 3 uses)

450.$description: light-mode hover/pressed ACCENT FILL step (play-pill hover, primary-button hover) — fills and non-text derivatives ONLY. The w26.f15 claim ('measures 4.2:1 surface / 4.6:1 panel') was arithmetically false (h20 F2): #B35F0D measures 2.59:1 on #c2c2c2, 2.70:1 on #c6c6c6, 2.50:1 on the light accent tint #d8ba9a (3.42:1 on raised only) — it is NOT certified as text anywhere in light mode. Light accent TEXT pairings use content-primary on tinted fills (w26.d2 ruling, button.css light overrides); fills stay orange per the frames. One truth: no component may set small text to this value in light mode.

425.$description: w26.i19 light-mode FOCUS RING / non-text accent boundary (h05 F1: the theme-invariant #d37918 ring measures 1.40:1 on chrome #ababab, 1.81:1 on surface, 1.89:1 on panel — WCAG 2.2 2.4.11/1.4.11 need 3:1 for focus indicators). This step MEASURES 3.26:1 on chrome, 3.38:1 on selected, 3.61:1 on hover, 3.86:1 on deep, 4.21:1 on surface, 4.39:1 on panel, 4.52:1 on muted, 5.57:1 on raised — ≥3:1 against every light surface. Consumed via --color-focus-ring (theme sheet light override); dark keeps the accent ring (6.18:1 on #090909). Not accent-family: alternate accents inherit this calibrated ring in light (per-accent light rings need the AccentRamp model — logged w26.i19).

600.$description: darker accent: pressed fills, ON-knob (232 fills)

accent.$description: The 8 alternate accent primaries — settings 'Accent color' swatches, drawn at 70% rest opacity (W25 §1 swatch set, frame: Settings - global-1.svg / Onboarding-1.svg swatch rows). The 9th (default) accent is orange.500. Derivative steps are computed (see $extensions.accent-derivation).

eq.$description: The 7 equalizer band/level accents — fixed design colors, independent of the user accent selection (W25 §1 EQ band set) /* frame: EQ.svg */

font.$description: Type scale from outlined-text cap-heights (doc 08 §1.3): font-size = cap/0.72, rounded [VERIFY-DESIGN]. W25 §1 type scale (10-15px compact body) is applied by screens; these roles carry the mined scale. Family/weights are the W25 stack (fidelity spec §1).

sidebar.$description: sidebar/menu medium rows (W25 §1: '13px sidebar/menu medium'; lane asks a10/a05)

section.$description: section headings semibold (W25 §1: '14–15px section headings'; lane asks a08/b13)

time.$description: cap 11.1px, tabular digits (00:02:10) — condensed/tabular face distinctness is [VERIFY-DESIGN]

label.$description: cap 11.8px → nominal 16px [VERIFY-DESIGN]; re-valued to 15px by w26.i19 — CONTRACT §2 pins the product type band at 10–15px and h19/h20 flag the 16px label as the band violation (a18 asked for a 15px carrier; i09 logged the standing ask). The contract band trumps cap-height mining; 15px also serves the a18 dialog-title/tool-toggle heading role (frame: 15px/600 titles)

sans.$description: UI face — the W25 geometric-sans stack (fidelity spec §1); replaces the Solstice Nunito face

time.$description: timecode face — same UI stack; apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for tabular timecodes (W25 §1). Guidance note: the DTCG $type subset has no font-variant type, so the tabular-numeric rule lives here as prose

regular.$description: body weight [PROPOSAL] from outline stroke thickness (doc 08 §1.3) [VERIFY-DESIGN]

radius.$description: Working ramp per doc 08 §1.4 + W25 §1 radii: 1 chips · 2-3 micro · 4 inputs/swatches · 6 buttons/dropdowns/menu items (559 uses) · 8 settings footer · 10-12 menus/popovers · 12-14 cards/panels (180x12, 98x14) · 19-21 sheets/main window · 30 hero pills. Consolidations [PROPOSAL]: 3 (188) -> 4; 5 (163) -> 6; 20 (album art) -> 19; 4.5 (35) excluded as annotation chrome. Rounding lives on CONTROLS; panels are square-edged (W25 §1).

4.$description: inputs, swatches, seek fill/thumb, toggle knob [3 consolidated] (354) — W25 r4 inputs

6.$description: default control radius: buttons, dropdowns, menu items, segments, toggle, seek [5 consolidated] (559) — the W25 workhorse

8.$description: settings footer bar / thumbnails (W25 §2 Settings footer r8)

12.$description: menus/popovers, onboarding theme cards, settings rows (180) — W25 r10-12 menus

14.$description: cards: settings window, miniplayer cards (98) — W25 r12-14 cards

16.$description: miniplayer floating card lower bound (W25 §2 miniplayer r16-20)

20.$description: miniplayer floating card upper bound (W25 §2 miniplayer r16-20)

30.$description: hero pills / large cards (9) — kept distinct

space.$description: 4px base grid with 8px component padding [PROPOSAL over VERIFY-DESIGN data, doc 08 §1.4]. 20px annotation padding excluded (not design).

48.$description: item pitch upper bound (42-48 observed; menu items 48) [PROPOSAL]

width.$description: Stroke widths (doc 08 §1.4): icon 1.5 (3464 uses), 2 and 3 for emphasis; ring 4 (selection rings, inset rings); window border 20. Artboard-scaled copies (0.825/1.125/1.28571) excluded.

shadow.$description: Drop shadows from feColorMatrix/feGaussianBlur/feOffset chains (doc 08 §1.1, §1.4) — neutral black, measured.

overlay.$description: stronger variant (blur 5.9, black 70%); dy assumed 4.76 [PROPOSAL — only blur+alpha observed for this variant]

blur.$description: Backdrop blur radii (doc 08 §1.1): Figma blur 50 => 25px CSS; the 13.75px pair sits on smaller panels (Figma 27.5).

opacity.$description: Alpha carried separately from hue (doc 08 §1.2). Keys are percent.

alias.$description: Layer 2 of 3 (doc 08 §3.2): theme roles — the names we expect to recover as Figma variables. Per-mode values where the role flips between dark and light (W25 §1 light table). Light values marked [PROPOSAL] were derived (unobserved in the single light frame).

surface.$description: base surface: main window, menus, icon rail, dropdown lists

surface.deep.$description: wells: seek track, chips, input bg, toggle track. Light = #bababa (g03/g05 Lead light-frame repin — the sidebar column / recessed wells). NOTE: the light SEEK/VOLUME track is NOT this role — Player - Light.svg's lone #DEDEDE rect (1238×28 r6 at (254,1039)) is surface.raised in light, delivered via the theme-sheet track override (w26.i19); in dark the seek track is surface (Player.svg Frame 21 #090909).

surface.panel.$description: panels: sidebar/cards on dark, translucent over video (alpha via opacity.panel)

surface.chrome.$description: title bar / control strip (alpha via opacity.chrome); dark re-pinned to the frame's #1B1B1B (Player.svg topbar/strip, g03-P2-1 + h03 #3) — w26.i02

surface.raised.$description: raised: thumbnails, elevated rows; light value [PROPOSAL] white

surface.elevated.$description: elevated panel: card-on-panel lift (i09 +2 ask). Dark = gray.775 #1B1B1B, panel +2 — the tools frames' expanded-card fill on the #191919 panel (analysis/tools-settings.md; i09 previously borrowed raised #222222, +9). Light = gray.115 #c9c9c9, panel +3 — the smallest designated lift in the Lead-pinned light ramp; light depth steps stay compressed (wells Δ4, h20 F4 — systemic to the pinned ramp, needs a light-frame re-pin with more range). Pair with stroke.border for edge definition in light.

surface.muted.$description: off-knob, waveform bars, tertiary fills; light value [PROPOSAL] derived

content.secondary.$description: secondary text; w26.i19: light repinned to the WCAG-adjusted gray.470 #3a3a3a (mined #4e4e4e measured 3.62:1 on chrome / 4.29:1 on deep — AA needs 4.5; new step clears 4.5:1 on EVERY light surface, h05 F3)

content.tertiary.$description: tertiary/disabled/OFF labels; w26.i19 one-truth repin: dark gray.425 + light gray.465 #474747 (the f15 doc/ship split-brain — gray.325 #767676 documented vs gray.460 #5f5f5f shipped, both sub-AA — is closed: the DELIVERED value now measures ≥4.5:1 on surface/panel/deep/muted/raised, h20 F1). Scope: NOT for chrome/hover/selected text.

content.quiet.$description: the frames' quiet band — decorative glyphs, marks, ticks, chevrons, shortcut hints and inactive/disabled labels (WCAG 1.4.3 inactive-UI exemption). Added w26.i19 (i07 three-wave ask g15-P2-1/g16-P3-1/h14-5; i13 arbitration). Dark = gray.450 #6B6B6B — the mined 501-fill value, ≥3:1 non-text on surface 3.74:1 / deep 3.62:1 / panel 3.30:1 / muted 3.43:1 / chrome #1b1b1b 3.23:1, NOT raised (2.99) or hover (2.84). Light = gray.460 #5F5F5F — 3.58:1 surface / 3.74:1 panel / 3.29:1 deep / 3.86:1 muted, NOT chrome #ababab (2.78:1) or selected #aeaeae (2.88:1). ARBITRATION (i13): #6B6B6B is NOT content.tertiary — as TEXT it measures 3.30:1 on #191919 (sub-AA for the 14–15px labels it carries); tertiary keeps the WCAG steps (#828282/#474747), quiet carries the frame value for non-text/inactive scope only.

content.bright.$description: strongest text (headings, active labels, miniplayer titles); light value measured (#161616 emphasis glyphs, Player - Light.svg)

content.on-accent.$description: glyph on accent fills — dark ink on orange pills (W25 §1); per-accent contrast selection per doc 08 §3.3

accent.$description: primary accent — constant across themes (play button); per-accent; orange is the default

accent.bright.$description: hover/lighter accent; w26.f15: light repinned to the WCAG-adjusted orange.450 TEXT step (e17 F2 — orange.300 ≈2.3:1 on light failed) w26.gfix-C: dark bright repinned to the contract §2 hover #e8851a (orange.300).

accent.strong.$description: darker accent: pressed fills, ON-knob; per-accent

accent.tinted.$description: accent-tinted fill: glow on dark, wash on light (seek progress, segmented selected, toggle ON track); per-accent

stroke.border.$description: hairline border stroke; w26.i19: light repinned to gray.300 #9a9a9a (ΔRGB 17 from chrome #ababab — the mined gray.172 #acacac sat ΔRGB 1 and killed every separator + the onboarding stepper dots, h05 F5)

focus.ring.$description: keyboard focus ring (UI state — WCAG 2.2 2.4.11/1.4.11 non-text 3:1). Dark = the accent ring as shipped (6.18:1 on #090909 — unchanged); light = the calibrated orange.425 #824505, ≥3:1 against every light surface (the accent #d37918 ring measured 1.40–2.39:1 in light, h05 F1). Consumed by the theme sheet's light focus override; NOT accent-family — per-accent light rings need the AccentRamp model (w26.i19 lane log).

time.$description: time readouts (tabular — pair with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums)
timecode face — same stack, tabular-nums guidance (W25 §1)

track-inset.$description: inner inset on filled tracks [PROPOSAL naming]

item-pitch.$description: list item pitch [PROPOSAL: upper bound of 42-48]

hairline.$description: micro rounding: chips, swatch corners, thumbs

panel.$description: floating panel corners (W25 §1 cards/panels r12-14); in-window panels are square-edged

inset.$description: inputs, swatches, inner track rounding (W25 §1 r4)

control.$description: default control radius: buttons, dropdowns, menu items, segments, toggles (W25 §1 r6 — 559 uses)

thumbnail.$description: thumbnails, small media tiles (W25 §2 settings footer r8)

semantic.$description: Layer 3 of 3 (doc 08 §3.2): the ONLY layer components may consume. Every token resolves through an alias, never directly to a primitive (enforced by the parser). CSS name = --{category}-{name}; Rust const = {CATEGORY}_{NAME}. Mode-dependent tokens flip with [data-theme]; accent-family tokens flip with [data-accent] (doc 08 §3.3).

surface.elevated.$description: elevated panel — card-on-panel lift (+2 dark / +3 light on panel)

content.quiet.$description: quiet band — decorative marks, ticks, chevrons, shortcut hints, inactive/disabled labels (non-text scope; NOT body text — use tertiary)

content.on-accent.$description: glyph on accent fills; switches per accent

focus.ring.$description: focus ring color — theme the :focus-visible outline with this in light mode (WCAG 2.2 3:1); dark equals the accent
